_readme: TUNING [the job's stars, the cut-offs] (rule 208(b)(f); research only). draft:true. NOTHING IN THE GAME READS THIS FILE. Each job is a live-fight board the map could hand (tools/bohemia_tuning_the_job_stars.js); read: the calculator's runs on its own seed, one digit a run (1 = clean: won, nobody of his dead or down); read2: 24 runs on other dice (the flicker test); clean and won: of 100 more plays (the truth); readOk, read2Ok, ok: the big-crew reading (won, nobody dead, at most one man in six laid up; for a crew under six it is clean, copied from the first pass); deaths: plays of the 100 with a man dead (null where copied). grid: every pair of cut-offs tried on the read, both readings (m).
